tradeoffs.J01: SELECT: mandatory primary runtime-adjusted leader, IoU 0.720016592 and utility 0.719998232. Original-H&E-conducted appearance remains the strongest aggregate compromise. Native BCSS01 still shows false gold fringes, TIGER23 loses thin tissue, and OCELOT21/31 merge gland profiles. Retain the leader without claiming anatomical correctness on every image.
tradeoffs.M04: SELECT: second adjusted utility, replacing L02 with positive observation-noise sampling variance. It removes the need to clip negative inverse-diagonal estimates in this new variance law; finite probes and assumed noise remain uncalibrated. IoU is effectively J01-level, not a meaningful accuracy gain. Retain this numerically coherent uncertainty branch rather than several near-identical field candidates.
tradeoffs.K05: SELECT: strongest raw IoU among these five and a distinct bending-field hypothesis; small-region recall 0.2161 versus J01 0.1985 on calibrated cases. Native BCSS01 also exposes a false gold rim and TIGER23 remains wrong. Its 28 images over one second are penalized; it does not beat J01 utility. M07/M08/M09 do not justify their additional runtime.
tradeoffs.M11: SELECT as the explicit background branch, replacing L03: mean IoU rises 0.000610519 and utility 0.000760207 versus L03. Native TIGER28 shows preservation of valid fat interiors that L03 deletes, and RINGS22 avoids a large luminal deletion. However it loses on 219 cases versus 58 wins and creates straight-ray artifacts; this is a deliberate tissue-preservation tradeoff, not broad dominance or a top-five-utility claim.
tradeoffs.C17: SELECT as the fastest distinct palette inverse: 0.15936 seconds mean, zero images over one second, with checked native inverse residuals. Native BCSS01 and BCSS60 favor its suppression of false fringes. It still erases or merges some small regions and loses fine gland topology. All three palette children have lower raw IoU and utility; direct affine pixel inversion differs from their occupied-node/prior approximations.
tradeoffs.L02: REJECT from next roster: M04 has slightly higher raw IoU and adjusted utility while using a positive sampling-variance law instead of the clipped approximate inverse-system diagonal. M05 also improves L02 raw IoU but costs more. Keep the signed historical implementation for reproducibility, not as another near-duplicate survivor.
tradeoffs.L03: REJECT from next roster: M11 preserves valid fat in native TIGER28 and avoids the large labelled-tumour lumen deletion in RINGS22. L03 still opens the real BCSS07/54 clefts, but its broader glass removal deletes annotated tissue elsewhere. M11 has higher aggregate IoU/utility, although its ray artifacts and many case regressions remain documented.
tradeoffs.M01: REJECT: latent true-class EM reduces J01 IoU by 0.002569992 with 132 wins,185 losses,32 ties and 43 images over one second. It produces fragmented or false islands, including WSSS22, without restoring absent tissue classes. Monotone aggregated-observation EM energy does not ensure anatomical accuracy or convergence after eight updates.
tradeoffs.M02: REJECT despite high adjusted rank: exact first-moment conservation changes little, loses mean IoU versus J01 with154 wins,163 losses,32 ties, and retains the same fringe and topology failures. Its measured mean time is slightly lower but not controlled speedup evidence. M04 retains a more useful uncertainty intervention without taking multiple near-duplicate field slots.
tradeoffs.M03: REJECT: series-resistance stain transport lowers J01 IoU by 0.002806643 with117 wins versus200 losses. Actual OCELOT12/32 and CAMELYON01 show false hollow tumour rings; BCSS/TIGER show repeated rough outlines. Subgrid nuclear barriers create artificial holes rather than recover the fine true gland/stromal network.
tradeoffs.M05: REJECT narrowly: Student predictive density improves L02 raw IoU by only0.000227619 (0.02276 percentage points),169 wins versus146 losses, with9 images over one second. Native WSSS22 improves some green arms but BCSS60 regresses and fine glands remain lost. M04 has higher adjusted utility and avoids inherited inverse-diagonal clipping; no broad gain over J01 is established.
tradeoffs.M06: REJECT: exact expected squared appearance risk is slightly worse than L02 in raw IoU and materially lower in adjusted utility. It retains the inherited approximate uncertainty estimator, with7 images over one second. Native TIGER23 and the complete overviews show no recovery of the thin tissue partitions that would justify another similar field branch.
tradeoffs.M07: REJECT: free-boundary Hessian regularity gains just0.000074210 raw IoU over K05 (0.00742 points),169 wins versus145 losses, but lowers utility by0.000719290. It slightly raises small-region recall without resolving false gold rims or merged glands.29 images over one second and near-parent masks do not justify replacing K05.
tradeoffs.M08: REJECT: within-tile Hermite observations lower K05 raw IoU,116 wins versus200 losses, and cost more.29 images exceed one second. Native TIGER23 and OCELOT gland examples remain structurally wrong; reusing observed gradients does not restore the lost fine networks.
tradeoffs.M09: REJECT despite highest raw IoU0.722214629: cross-class repulsion gains0.001609074 over K05 but90 images exceed one second and adjusted utility drops0.009188170. Native WSSS13 improves one red rim while WSSS22 regresses; BCSS01 false gold and gland merges persist. Three finite solves miss stationarity, maximum gradient4.28336e-5. Accuracy gains do not justify cost under the frozen penalty.
tradeoffs.M10: REJECT: integrated-stain exterior paths slightly lower L03 raw IoU (77 wins,90 losses,182 ties). It deletes valid fat in native TIGER28 and narrows tissue despite some useful cleft access. Lower mean runtime than L03 is not sufficient; M11 preserves more labelled tissue and has higher utility.
tradeoffs.M12: REJECT: global glass mincut lowers L03 IoU by0.001540780 and has the most additional annotated unassignment among the glass candidates. Native CAMELYON01 shows lattice-like fat holes; RINGS22 deletes central tumour lumen and upper gland lumina. A cut certificate proves optimization of its discrete energy, not correctness of the tissue/glass interpretation.
tradeoffs.M13: REJECT: byte-interval deadzone inverse lowers C17 IoU by0.003084567 with105 wins versus212 losses and adds grey halos in native TIGER23 and BCSS examples. Half-byte modeling does not fix larger conversion/identifiability errors. Occupied-node quantization and prior also differ from C17, so this is a complete-implementation comparison.
tradeoffs.M14: REJECT: counterfactual class necessity lowers C17 IoU by0.008055151,88 wins versus229 losses. It deletes true grey tissue, dramatically in BCSS58 and native BCSS20, despite suppressing some false fringes. Palette vertices inside rival hulls can be unnecessary even when biologically present. Higher small-region recall does not compensate for systematic class loss.
tradeoffs.M15: REJECT: robust calibration inverse lowers C17 IoU by0.002318870,115 wins versus202 losses, and adds native TIGER23 grey halos.100 cases reach the finite ADMM cap without all residual criteria; max primal5.46167e-5,dual7.39931e-5,Lagrangian projected residual5.08314e-5. Robustness and checked inner QP residuals do not establish the outer solution or improved anatomy.
